results.name: Sidebar disclosure and collapse preserve access to every role-aware destination
A room tap writes once, immediately closes the sheet, and offers persistent Undo
An intervening room update prevents Undo from overwriting newer state
Offline room actions do not write or dismiss the picker
Manual input and keyboard segmented selection retain their focus
Mobile has four stable destinations and secondary tools via account/search
Symbol feedback is finite and Reduce Motion cancels active feedback
Calendar Today and filters remain available after layout changes
Combo selection retains required recipient and writes only selected tasks
Import still blocks unreviewed rows and separates the six real seed conflicts
Text zoom reflows the main flows at narrow widths

limitations: Custom web icon vectors; no SF asset distribution
